script.title: Captain Tempo Counts the Crossing
script.synopsis: At a busy junction Captain Tempo counts down THREE, TWO, ONE, AND with her whole body; the signal flips on its own timer; she erupts into the Tempo Stomp as if she caused it; a commuter walks through her celebration without a glance and the camera lingers one beat too long.

beats.beat: Wide low shot: towering teal-and-gold woman, arms raised like a conductor, red figure glowing; downbeat on THREE
Conducting arms and bounce build; the countdown is the rule stated aloud
TWO shouted, then a silent whistle blast with lips sealed, then the roar of ONE; push-in tightens
AND: the signal flips on its own timer; Tempo Stomp
Commuter walks through her frozen victory; camera lingers one beat too long

scenes.action: Wide, slightly low across the road: Captain Tempo stands at the kerb, both arms raised, hands open, red standing figure glowing on the signal behind her. Her arms drop on THREE and rise again on TWO, mouth open to shout, whistle hanging on its cord and metronome clipped to the waistband; the handheld camera begins its slow push-in. Feet, signal pole and kerb stay still.

scenes.location: Pedestrian crossing at a busy junction, grey city street, kerb on the near side of the road, signal pole behind her
scenes.action: On AND she shouts, mouth open, and the signal behind her flips from red standing figure to green walking figure on its own timer. Her white trainers stomp twice, her hips swing and both empty fists thrust to the sky; the whistle swings on its cord. The blurred crowd begins crossing without looking at her. Signal pole and kerb stay still.
scenes.performance: Holds the instant of the flip with certainty, then grins wide through the Tempo Stomp, whistle hanging on its cord.
scenes.microexpression: Gap-toothed grin explodes wide, eyebrows lifting skyward with the fists.
